title: 법원통계규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Collection of Statistics)
(1) In principle, statistics shall be collected by the National Court Administration through the judicial affairs information system, the registration information system, and the family relationship registration system.
(2) Specific methods of collecting statistics using each system referred to in the preceding paragraph shall be prescribed by the Court Statistics Directives.
(3) Where statistics cannot be collected by the methods referred to in the preceding paragraph, they shall be collected through ad hoc reports, and the reporting methods shall be prescribed by the Court Statistics Directives.
